name: White Court
summary: A broad rounded prayer hall and one slim square minaret form a calm whitewashed courtyard mosque.
why: The rounded hall and generous horseshoe opening share x=47. The tall minaret joins the hall through a low courtyard wall, and every part ends on y=72. Sandstone trim is attached to the tower and courtyard cornice.
risk: The large horseshoe opening is intentionally more prominent than the minaret. At 24 px it becomes a broad, welcoming keyhole shape.
reasonToChoose: You want a distinctive horseshoe entrance with a restrained mosque silhouette.
